final: WITH patient_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total FROM patient_counts), ratios AS (SELECT pc.ID, pc.record_count, CAST(pc.record_count AS REAL) / tc.total AS ratio FROM patient_counts AS pc CROSS JOIN total_count AS tc WHERE tc.total IS NOT NULL), average_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ratios) SELECT r.ID, r.record_count, r.ratio, r.ratio - a.avg_ratio AS difference FROM ratios AS r CROSS JOIN average_ratio AS a WHERE a.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
